title: Remittance Sent with a Returned Title & Registration Services Packet
content:
When a returned Title & Registration Services packet goes back to the state, Kestrel remits every state fee held on the order with it as one remittance entry for the total, and the order is made ready again and submitted on that day in the same action. Kestrel pays its own cost of a stated shortage with the remittance: when the order's most recent fee-shortage return states an amount and no remittance has been made since that return, Kestrel adds the rest of the stated shortage, which is the stated shortage less the buyer's cure share collected for it as a registration-fee entry on or after that return, never below zero. The remittance is the total of these, rounded half up to the cent.

## Definitions

| Term | Meaning on the records |
|---|---|
| state fees held | the amount of state fees held shown on the title order at the moment the packet goes back |
| most recent fee-shortage return | the latest-dated state rejection entry on the order whose reason is fee shortage |
| stated shortage | the amount stated on that return |
| no remittance since that return | the order carries no remittance entry to the state dated on or after the date of that return |
| buyer's cure share collected for it | the amount of the order's most recent registration-fee entry when that entry is dated on or after the return; nothing otherwise |

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders)

1. The most recent fee-shortage return, dated 9 May, states 60.00; the last remittance is dated 2 May; the buyer's registration-fee entry of 24.00 is dated 12 May; the order holds 24.00 in state fees. Kestrel's part is 60.00 less 24.00, that is 36.00, and the remittance is 24.00 and 36.00 together, 60.00.
2. Same return, but the buyer's cure share collected is 72.00 and the order holds 72.00 in state fees: 60.00 less 72.00 is below zero, so Kestrel's part is nothing and the remittance is the 72.00 held.
3. The most recent fee-shortage return states 0.00 and the order holds 25.21 in state fees: Kestrel's part is nothing and the remittance is 25.21.
4. A remittance is already dated 9 May, the day of the return: a remittance has been made since that return, so Kestrel's part is nothing and the remittance is the state fees held.
